_doc: Eye point of the camera layer in comp px (the base is drawn at 3413x1920). ex/ey = eye centre; eyeY = where the eyes sit in FULL; splitZoom/splitEyeY = the SPLIT framing; pushAnchorY = the chin line FULL punch-ins scale about (keeps under-chin captions clear). Measure on the real (synced) raw and add a key per version; a stand-in version reuses the values of the take its placeholder frame came from.
